name: Billing Match
office_task: Every morning, check each customer's CRM billing details against Xero by account id, show each difference with both values and the owning system, and fix one only once a named person accepts it.
systems_of_record: the CRM (issues the customer account id; owns billing email, billing address and ABN)
Xero (the invoicing ledger; carries the CRM account id on the contact and owns the invoiced total, last invoice date and payment terms)

emits.write: the run's reconciliation report where accounts open it: the field-ownership contract it ran under, the key it joined on (crm_account_id), the owner per field, and the counts matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned and corrected, published every run including the all-clear
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the customer account naming the person who owns it: an open difference with the CRM value, the Xero value and the owning system's value side by side awaiting acceptance, an orphan on one side, a gap over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the crm_account_id, the field, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: Reconcile CRM and invoicing owner fields with HTTPS APIs and Data Tables
